description:
The API should answer invalid or extreme input with a clear client error (4xx)
  or accept it safely – but it must NEVER fail with a server error (5xx).

elements.name: Baseline – a valid post is created

steps.name: I create a post with a valid payload
the response status should be 201
the response should echo the submitted fields
the response should contain a numeric "id"

elements.name: Excessively long title (256 characters) does not cause a server failure

steps.name: I create a post whose title is 256 characters long
the API should not fail with a server error
the response status should be one of "201, 400, 413"
if the post was accepted the title should be stored without truncation
the response should arrive within 10000 ms
